candidates.base_prompt:
A warm storybook cartoon illustration for Keywright, a cosy fantasy shop game, based on the approved C2 reference's rounded shapes, warm colours, readable faces and crafted objects, but WITHOUT ANY OUTLINES. Separate shapes with adjacent colour fills and two or three cel-shaded material tones, never inked contour strokes. No black, dark plum or other coloured line tracing around silhouettes or inside shapes; no comic linework, border strokes or dark halos. Natural eyes, small facial features, material seams and cast-shadow areas may stay dark where needed, but never form an encircling stroke. A script makes chunky 4x pixel art afterwards: draw a smooth illustration, not a pixel grid. Keep recognisable, purposeful detail: three or four bold features per figure or object where the small size permits, such as a patch, a seam, a nail head, a tied cord or a carved mark, expressed as filled shapes. Larger scenery can have grouped flowers, fences and signs of daily use at its edges. Preserve broad areas between these features; no all-over speckling, hatching, fine grain or individual hair strands. Keep details broad enough to survive reduction. Use two or three main cel-shaded tones per material and a restrained highlight; distant scenery has softer, lighter colour contrast. Soft, muted, warm colours; shadows lean violet, lights warm yellow, one gentle light from the upper left, neutral daylight. Plain writing areas stay plain. No text, letters, numbers or rune-like marks. Flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) means empty: never use magenta or hot pink in the subject itself.

Old Aldo: a full-length figure for a game, standing upright, from the top of the head (or hat) to the feet, centred and filling about ninety percent of the picture's height. Turned a little toward the right, looking right or at the viewer. Storybook proportions, the head about a fifth of the height; arms relaxed. The face in flat skin tones, the eyes clear dark dots and a simple mouth, readable from across a room. Background: flat pure magenta #FF00FF, nothing else in the picture.

Subject: A tired old man in a plain grey wool cloak to his ankles with the hood pushed back: secretly King Aldric IX. A white beard, kind weary eyes, and a fine gold ring with a ruby on one hand, the only rich thing about him.

It must show: the plain grey hooded cloak; the ruby ring. Keep these features readable after reduction.

Lean on these palette colours (dark to light; the swatch has them all): skin 3-5 (#bd7e5f #e1a882 #fed5b3); night 5-8 (#554b69 #766d8b #9b92ad #c9c4d4); gold 5 (#f2c14e); crimson 4 (#c7414e).

Avoid: a background or floor; a shadow; a frame; small accessories crowding the figure; strands of hair; a weapon unless described; outlines, contour strokes or ink linework; pixel-art style or visible pixels; all-over texture, grain, hatching or noise; airbrushed gradients; details too thin to survive reduction; highlights scattered over surfaces; unmotivated decorative clutter.
candidates.appended_text:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-length game character, continuation of the approved C2/4x NO-OUTLINE figure anchor. Reference 1 is approved Hob for the rounded forms, expressive face, cel-shaded colour shapes and useful detail ONLY. One high-quality PNG, requested size 1024x1536. Keep the whole body including every hat/horn and both feet completely inside the image, modest clear magenta margin, no crop. The pixelizer will place it on a 96x160 canvas with whole silhouette height 118 pixels. Head about one fifth of the figure; clear face, broad hands, relaxed stance turned a little right. Preserve the stated identity and signature details as bold filled shapes, without inked outer or internal outlines. Broad two-or-three-tone skin and clothing areas, restrained folds, no strands or surface grain. Flat pure magenta in all empty areas, no background, floor or cast ground shadow. No decorative objects not described.

Skin-colour correction learned from the first figures: human skin uses muted natural rosy-peach #e1a882 with #bd7e5f shadow and #fed5b3 light. No gold, yellow or saturated orange patches on human skin; neutral daylight, not golden sunset light. Preserve the specified age, face and clothing.

Separate shapes with adjacent colour fills and two or three cel-shaded material tones, never inked contour strokes. No black, dark plum or other coloured line tracing around silhouettes or inside shapes; no comic linework, border strokes or dark halos. Natural eyes, small facial features, material seams and cast-shadow areas may stay dark where needed, but never form an encircling stroke. A script makes chunky 4x pixel art afterwards: draw a smooth illustration, not a pixel grid. Keep recognisable, purposeful detail: three or four bold features per figure or object where the small size permits, such as a patch, a seam, a nail head, a tied cord or a carved mark, expressed as filled shapes. Larger scenery can have grouped flowers, fences and signs of daily use at its edges. Preserve broad areas between these features; no all-over speckling, hatching, fine grain or individual hair strands. Keep details broad enough to survive reduction. Use two or three main cel-shaded tones per material and a restrained highlight; distant scenery has softer, lighter colour contrast. Soft, muted, warm colours; shadows lean violet, lights warm yellow, one gentle light from the upper left, neutral daylight. Plain writing areas stay plain. No text, letters, numbers or rune-like marks. Flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) means empty: never use magenta or hot pink in the subject itself.

Mister Vane: a full-length figure for a game, standing upright, from the top of the head (or hat) to the feet, centred and filling about ninety percent of the picture's height. Turned a little toward the right, looking right or at the viewer. Storybook proportions, the head about a fifth of the height; arms relaxed. The face in flat skin tones, the eyes clear dark dots and a simple mouth, readable from across a room. Background: flat pure magenta #FF00FF, nothing else in the picture.

Subject: Collector of the Gilded Guild, tall and thin: a pale gaunt face, slicked-back black hair, cold grey eyes, a thin polite smile, a long high-collared black coat with gold buttons, the Guild's small gold eye-and-keyhole pin.

It must show: pale gaunt face and slicked-back hair; the long high-collared black coat. Keep these features readable after reduction.

Lean on these palette colours (dark to light; the swatch has them all): skin 4-5 (#e1a882 #fed5b3); night 1-3 (#0b0810 #1a1420 #2b2236); gold 4-5 (#c29026 #f2c14e).

Avoid: a background or floor; a shadow; a frame; small accessories crowding the figure; strands of hair; a weapon unless described; outlines, contour strokes or ink linework; pixel-art style or visible pixels; all-over texture, grain, hatching or noise; airbrushed gradients; details too thin to survive reduction; highlights scattered over surfaces; unmotivated decorative clutter.
candidates.appended_text:
